name: move
doc: Move one tile in the given direction.

name: mine
doc: Mine the tile the miner stands on. Returns a dict with ok, and reason or ore when relevant.

name: peek
doc: Return the ore on the current tile, None if empty, or 'unknown' if the ore is locked.

name: position
doc: Return the miner position as (x, y).

name: sell
doc: Sell the whole inventory at the base and return the money gained.

name: inventory
doc: Return the inventory as a dict of ore id to count.

name: scan
doc: Scan for ore within radius tiles. Returns a list of (dx, dy, ore_id) for non-empty tiles.
cost: 1 + radius ticks (radius capped by the scanner)
example: for dx, dy, ore in scan(2): ...

name: stats
doc: Return per-ore mining statistics as {ore: {'attempts': n, 'successes': m}}.

name: buy_upgrade
doc: Buy the next level of the given upgrade and return the new level.

name: wait
doc: Wait for ticks (1 to 600) without doing anything else.

name: distance
doc: Return the Chebyshev distance from the base at (0, 0).

name: biome
doc: Return the id of the biome under the miner.

name: ore_info
doc: Return {id, name, tier, hardness, base_value, regen_ticks} for a known ore, or None when it is unknown or locked. The mining probability is never included.

name: inspect
doc: Return {ore, mineable, reason, regrows_in} for the current tile.

name: submit_estimate
doc: Submit an estimate p for the mining probability of an ore after at least 100 attempts. Allows three submissions per ore and returns {ok, close}.
